# anecdotes_framework_folder (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing folder by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a framework folder by name and read the frameworks it contains.
data "anecdotes_framework_folder" "security" {
  name = "Security Frameworks"
}

output "folder_frameworks" {
  value = data.anecdotes_framework_folder.security.frameworks_list
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the folder to look up.

### Read-Only

- `folder_id` (String) The unique identifier for the folder.
- `frameworks_list` (List of String) List of framework IDs in this folder.
